versions.changelog:
pans-meeting-summarizer 1.0.0

- Initial release of an AI-based meeting summarizer for sales scenarios.
- Supports automatic transcription of meeting audio files (m4a, wav, mp3) and text records.
- Generates structured meeting minutes, action items with owners and deadlines, and customer insights.
- Enables one-click synchronization of meeting summaries and follow-up notes to CRM systems.
- Includes CLI options for flexible input, output format (Markdown/JSON), and CRM sync.
